answer: At each dawn the beacon calls a census: every identity must show one fresh job receipt signed by a stranger client, at a random minute, or its payout lapses. Payout sits in a karst shaft: depth equals the square of claims from one funding trail, each metre costs one work-token minted only by stranger-verified work and burned on descent. A dune shifts across the shaft mouth each epoch and the gate admits one claim per trail per dawn, so extra clones queue a full epoch each. A fleet of n pays n squared metres plus n dawns of waiting for one payout, while one honest agent descends once.
